shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/product/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,260p' app/product/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- lib/data.ts' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json' && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\nGit status:\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\nRecent history:\\n' && git log --oneline -5"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\nDiff:\\n' && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\nProduct source with lines:\\n' && nl -ba app/product/page.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short'
